Generate a GitHub Actions workflow for automated statci verification

Source: R/github-action.R
use_statci_github_action.Rd

Creates a hardened GitHub Actions workflow YAML file (default .github/workflows/statci.yaml) that installs R and package dependencies, runs statci statistical linting, optional manuscript auditing or custom calibration/sensitivity scripts, writes a GitHub-Flavored Markdown summary to $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY, uploads the standalone HTML audit dashboard as a workflow artifact, and enforces the statci pass/warn/fail gate.

Usage

use_statci_github_action(
  path = ".",
  file = ".github/workflows/statci.yaml",
  branches = c("main", "master"),
  r_version = "release",
  fail_on = c("fail", "warn"),
  lint_paths = c("R"),
  manuscript = NULL,
  models_path = NULL,
  audit_script = NULL,
  report_dir = "statci-reports",
  upload_artifact = TRUE,
  upload_sarif = FALSE,
  overwrite = FALSE
)

Arguments

path

Root project directory (default ".").

file

Workflow path relative to path (default ".github/workflows/statci.yaml"). Must resolve inside path.

branches

Character vector of branch names triggering push and pull_request workflows (default c("main", "master")).

r_version

R version specifier passed to r-lib/actions/setup-r (default "release"). Allowed values: "release", "devel", "oldrel", "oldrel-1".."oldrel-4", or a numeric version such as "4.4.2".

fail_on

CI gate level passed to statci_check_gate(): "fail" (default) or "warn".

lint_paths

Character vector of project-relative directories to scan with stat_lint_dir() when audit_script is NULL (default c("R")).

manuscript

Optional project-relative path to a .qmd/.Rmd manuscript to audit against models_path.

models_path

Optional project-relative path to an .rds file or directory of .rds model objects used with manuscript.

audit_script

Optional project-relative path to a custom R script (ending in .R or .r) that executes full estimator calibration, manuscript auditing, and sensitivity checks.

report_dir

Project-relative directory where HTML/Markdown audit artifacts are written (default "statci-reports").

upload_artifact

Logical; include an actions/upload-artifact step for HTML and Markdown audit reports? Default TRUE.

upload_sarif

Logical; if TRUE, export AST lint findings to SARIF 2.1.0 via export_statci_sarif() and add a github/codeql-action/upload-sarif step (also adds security-events: write permission). Default FALSE.

overwrite

Logical; overwrite existing workflow file? Default FALSE.

Value

Invisibly returns the normalized path to the generated YAML file.

Details

All user-supplied parameters (branches, r_version, lint_paths, manuscript, models_path, audit_script, report_dir, file) are strictly validated against path traversal, newline/YAML injection, and shell/R command injection, and passed into the runner strictly via workflow env: variables rather than interpolating untrusted strings into run: blocks.

Examples

tmp <- tempfile("statci_gh_")
dir.create(tmp)
wf <- use_statci_github_action(path = tmp, lint_paths = c("R", "analysis"))
file.exists(wf)
#> [1] TRUE
unlink(tmp, recursive = TRUE)
